title: Huddle bridge: Product + Eng + Applied ML — pre-sync notes
content:
Purpose: quick prep for cross-functional alignment huddle with Product (Priya), Eng infra (Lydia), and Applied ML (Arjun). Keep this tight: 30–40 min sync followed by 15 min focused on rollout blockers.

Context (one-liners):
- Product goal: lock priority items for H1 model rollout — minimize user-facing latency regressions while enabling larger context models for premium tier.
- Eng goal: settle autoscale + canary policy and KV cache defaults to hit 99th-percentile SLO without huge cost spikes.
- Applied ML goal: validate quantized variant quality and pick evaluation slices for regression monitoring.

Agenda (30–40m):
1) 0–5m: Quick alignment on desired outcome (Priya) — what decision do we need?
2) 5–15m: Eng brief (Lydia) — proposed canary policy, autoscale thresholds, region fallbacks.
3) 15–25m: ML brief (Arjun) — quantized 4-bit variant perf + eval summary. Known regression buckets.
4) 25–35m: Tradeoffs + decision — pin strategy for initial rollout (A/B vs progressive canary).
5) 35–40m: Action items, owners, deadlines.

Talking points / notes to bring:
- Canary policy proposal (from Lydia): two-phase canary: 5% traffic for 48h -> 20% for 72h -> full. Auto-roll back on latency > +15ms p99 or quality regression > 2% on key evals. (see ENG-INF-4821).
- ML asks: need stable baseline evals for: short-form help queries, long-context summarization, multi-turn slot-filling. Arjun: have sliced evals in ML-EVAL-220 but need product signoff on priority slices.
- Cost: Product is sensitive to 2–3x cost delta for large-context models; suggest gating premium tier for month 1 while we stabilize caching.
- KV cache note: current default TTL and cache-keying will leak prefixes for multi-tenant private deployments; propose per-tenant cache namespace. Engineering to confirm mem footprint for 2M keys.
- Rollout fallback: prefer model-variant fallback (smaller quantized variant) instead of region failover as first fallback, since region failover has broader infra impacts.
- Observability: need token-level cost breakdown for canary traffic and per-prompt latency histograms (console + telemetry hooks). Add tracing hooks for model selection decisions.

Open questions / risks to surface:
- ML: Is 4-bit quantization stable for long-context summarization (>=8k tokens)? Current test runs show token-level hallucination spikes in slice L8k-longform-1 in ML-EVAL-220. Need deeper root cause or revert plan.
- Eng: Does current batching config play nicely with canary low-traffic windows? We might see worse p99 due to smaller batch sizes; need simulation.
- Product: Is it acceptable to gate larger context features behind "premium" for initial geos? This affects GTM/comms.

Standalone asks before meeting (Jordan):
- Priya: mark the top 2 eval slices you care about for user-facing quality. (Due: 2026-03-18)
- Lydia: quick mem estimate and expected p99 delta for canary low-traffic scenario (simulate 5% traffic). (Due: 2026-03-18)
- Arjun: run extended L8k summarization runs on quant-4 and quant-8, attach diffs. Add error traces for hallucination spikes. (Due: 2026-03-17)

Proposed decision alternatives (preference order):
A) Progressive canary + model-variant fallback + enable prefix KV cache at tier-level (favored).
B) A/B rollout (50/50) for small subset of users + region fallback as backup.
C) Delay large-context launch until cache + quant regressions are resolved (conservative).

Quick script for the meeting (copy into calendar notes):
- Start: restate decision needed: "Choose rollout strategy and list gated features for phase 1."
- If ML shows large regressions: propose option C with timeline for mitigations.
- If Eng has no mem/batching blockers: lean A and record telemetry keys to monitor.

Context links to bring up:
- KV cache design doc (Confluence) — performance assumptions and tenant isolation notes.
- PR: serving-runtime batching change (PR #789) — may affect p99 under low qps.
- Eval ticket ML-EVAL-220 — slices and baseline metrics.

Notes-to-self: be explicit about rollback criteria (latency delta, quality delta) and tie them to concrete monitors/dashboards. Ask DS to add a short runbook for rollback steps if we flip model variant.

Tone: keep it practical, avoid academic debates about quantization until we have hard numbers. Focus on minimizing user impact and keeping the first rollout reversible.
action_items: Priya: pick top 2 eval slices and confirm customer-impact rationale — due 2026-03-18
Lydia: run memory + p99 simulation for 5% canary traffic and share numbers — due 2026-03-18
Arjun: extended quant-4 vs quant-8 L8k runs + attach diffs + error traces — due 2026-03-17
Jordan: prepare telemetry dashboard template (p99, token-cost, quality regression) and create console query links — due 2026-03-19
Eng infra: add tracing hook for model selection path in serving runtime PR #789 — owner: Lydia — due 2026-03-22
Product: draft comms blurb for gating large-context in premium tier (internal only) — owner: Priya — due 2026-03-20
